notes: HIP 39017 (HD 65526) is a γ Doradus-type pulsating variable, reclassified from a suspected eclipsing binary once multiple pulsation frequencies were identified (Handler+1999; Henry+2011). Tobin et al. 2024 adopt a young age of ≲115 Myr from its Gaia colour-magnitude position, which sits almost on top of the imaged-planet hosts HR 8799 and 51 Eri and near the Pleiades sequence. A statistically significant 5.5σ astrometric acceleration in the Hipparcos-Gaia Catalog of Accelerations (HGCA eDR3; Brandt+2021) flagged an unseen companion and motivated the SCExAO/CHARIS imaging search that discovered companion b (Tobin et al. 2024), which they describe as a 'massive planet or low-mass brown dwarf' with an L/T-transition spectrum. Companion b is tagged here with method imaging per atlas convention.
